tools.name: list_my_va_cases
tools.description:
List the veteran's OWN VA cases (read-only). Requires the veteran's
    personal VetAid agent key in the request's Authorization header
    (Bearer vak_...). Returns each case's id, status, timestamps, and its
    rated / denied / claimed conditions. Only ever returns the key owner's data.

tools.name: get_my_case_analysis
tools.description:
Get a per-stage analysis SUMMARY for one of the veteran's OWN cases
    (read-only; never runs a paid analysis). Requires the veteran's personal
    VetAid agent key in the request's Authorization header (Bearer vak_...).
    Returns 'not found' for any case the key owner does not own — no cross-use

tools.name: get_my_vetaid_account
tools.description:
Check the veteran's VetAid plan and remaining analysis credits BEFORE
    running an analysis (so you can tell them if they need to buy a credit).
    Requires the veteran's personal agent key (Bearer vak_...). Read-only.

tools.name: run_my_case_analysis
tools.description:
RUN the full VetAid analysis pipeline on one of the veteran's OWN cases,
    ON THE VETERAN'S BEHALF. This SPENDS one of the veteran's analysis credits
    (free plan: first 2 free, then $9.99 each) and takes ~5-8 minutes — afterward
    poll get_my_case_analysis(case_id) for the results.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: va_denial_stats, va_condition_intelligence, va_evidence_that_wins · Private data: va_evidence_that_wins · Public sink: va_condition_intelligence, va_manual_changes · Destructive: run_my_case_analysis.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: va_denial_stats, va_condition_intelligence, va_evidence_that_wins · Private data: va_evidence_that_wins · Public sink: va_condition_intelligence, va_manual_changes · Destructive: run_my_case_analysis

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
